name: batch_update_presentation
description:
Apply a batch of updates to a GridwellSlides presentation.

This function applies a series of specified update operations to a GridwellSlides
presentation in a single batch request. It allows for various modifications
such as creating slides, adding shapes, inserting text, deleting objects,
updating styles, and managing object groups, as defined by the list of `requests`.

IMPORTANT: Request parameter validation is performed by helper functions using
Pydantic models. This validation includes:
- Required fields: All required fields specified in the request type schemas (e.g.,
  'objectId' for deleteObject, 'objectId' and 'text' for insertText) are validated
  by the helper functions. Missing required fields will raise InvalidInputError.
- Enum values: All enum parameters (e.g., 'shapeType', 'predefinedLayout',
  'textRange.type') are validated by the helper functions to match the specified
  enum values. Invalid enum values will raise InvalidInputError.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to update.

requests.description:
A list of update requests to apply. Each object
in the array must be one of the specified request types. Each request
object typically has a single key identifying the type of request (e.g.,
'createSlide'), and its value is a dictionary containing the parameters
for that request.

VALIDATION: All required fields and enum values are validated by helper
functions using Pydantic models. Missing required fields or invalid enum
values will raise InvalidInputError.

The supported request types and their structures are:
- CreateSlideRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with a 'createSlide' key.
- CreateShapeRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with a 'createShape' key.
- InsertTextRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with an 'insertText' key.
- ReplaceAllTextRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with a 'replaceAllText' key.
- DeleteObjectRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with a 'deleteObject' key.
- DeleteTextRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with a 'deleteText' key.
- UpdateTextStyleRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with an 'updateTextStyle' key.
- GroupObjectsRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with a 'groupObjects' key.
- UngroupObjectsRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with an 'ungroupObjects' key.
- UpdatePageElementAltTextRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with an
  'updatePageElementAltText' key.
- UpdateSlidePropertiesRequest: Corresponds to a dictionary with an
  'updateSlideProperties' key.
(Note: For a complete list and details of all request types and their
parameters, refer to the GridwellSlides API documentation.)

items.description:
A single request item in a batch update.

Each field uses a specific request model that defines the expected properties.

Validation: Exactly one request type field must be set per item.

objectId.description: A user-supplied object ID. If specified, must be unique (1-50 chars, pattern [a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9_-:]*). If empty, a unique ID is generated.

insertionIndex.description: Optional zero-based index where to insert the slides. If unspecified, created at the end.

slideLayoutReference.description: Layout reference of the slide. If unspecified, uses a predefined BLANK layout. One of 'predefinedLayout' or 'layoutId' must be provided if 'slideLayoutReference' itself is provided.

layoutId.description: Layout ID of one of the layouts in the presentation.

placeholderIdMappings.description: Optional list of object ID mappings from layout placeholders to slide placeholders. Used only when 'slideLayoutReference' is specified. One of 'layoutPlaceholder' or 'layoutPlaceholderObjectId' must be provided.

items.description: Mapping from layout placeholder to slide placeholder.

objectId.description: User-supplied object ID for the new placeholder on the slide (1-50 chars, pattern [a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9_-:]*). If empty, a unique ID is generated.

layoutPlaceholder.description: The placeholder on a layout to be applied to a slide.

type.description: The type of the placeholder. Enum: ["TITLE", "BODY", "CENTERED_TITLE", "SUBTITLE", "DATE_AND_TIME", "FOOTER", "HEADER", "OBJECT", "CHART", "TABLE", "CLIP_ART", "PICTURE", "SLIDE_IMAGE", "SLIDE_NUMBER"].

index.description: The index of the placeholder. Usually 0. REQUIRED when layoutPlaceholder is present.

layoutPlaceholderObjectId.description: The object ID of the placeholder on a layout.

objectId.description: Optional user-supplied object ID for the shape (1-50 chars, pattern [a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9_-:]*). If empty, a unique ID is generated.

pageObjectId.description: The object ID of the page where the element is located.

size.description: The size of the page element.

transform.description: The transform of the page element.

shapeType.description: The type of shape to create.

insertText.description: Inserts text into a shape or table cell.

objectId.description: Object ID of the shape or table.

insertionIndex.description: Optional 0-based index where text will be inserted in Unicode code units.

replaceAllText.description: Replaces all instances of specified text.

replaceText.description: The text that will replace matched text.

matchCase.description: Indicates if the search should be case sensitive. Defaults to False.

searchByRegex.description: Optional. True if the find value should be treated as a regular expression. Defaults to False.

pageObjectIds.description: Optional. Limits matches to page elements only on the given page IDs.

deleteObject.description: Deletes a page or page element.

objectId.description: Object ID of the page or page element to delete.

deleteText.description: Deletes text from a shape or table cell.

objectId.description: Object ID of the shape or table.

textRange.description: The range of text to delete.

type.description: The type of range. ALL selects all text and takes no indices. FIXED_RANGE selects [startIndex, endIndex) and requires both. FROM_START_INDEX selects from startIndex to the end and requires startIndex only. RANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED must not be used.

startIndex.description: 0-based start index in Unicode code units. Required for FIXED_RANGE and FROM_START_INDEX; must be omitted for ALL.

endIndex.description: 0-based end index (exclusive) in Unicode code units. Required for FIXED_RANGE; must be omitted for FROM_START_INDEX and ALL.

updateTextStyle.description: Updates the styling of text within a Shape or Table.

objectId.description: Object ID of the shape or table with the text to be styled.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is struck through.

magnitude.description: The magnitude of the font size.

unit.description: The unit of the font size.

opaqueColor.description: Color container with keys: rgbColor, themeColor.

rgbColor.description: RGB components with keys: red, green, blue.

opaqueColor.description: Color container with keys: rgbColor, themeColor.

slideIndex.description: The zero-based index of the slide to link to.

pageObjectId.description: The object ID of the page to link to.

baselineOffset.description: The text's vertical offset from its normal position.

smallCaps.description: Whether the text is in small capital letters.

weightedFontFamily.description: The font family and rendered weight of the text.

textRange.description: The range of text to style.

type.description: The type of range. ALL selects all text and takes no indices. FIXED_RANGE selects [startIndex, endIndex) and requires both. FROM_START_INDEX selects from startIndex to the end and requires startIndex only. RANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED must not be used.

startIndex.description: 0-based start index in Unicode code units. Required for FIXED_RANGE and FROM_START_INDEX; must be omitted for ALL.

endIndex.description: 0-based end index (exclusive) in Unicode code units. Required for FIXED_RANGE; must be omitted for FROM_START_INDEX and ALL.

fields.description: Field mask (e.g., 'bold,fontSize') specifying which style fields to update. Use '*' for all fields.

groupObjectId.description: Optional user-supplied ID for the new group (1-50 chars, pattern [a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9_-:]*).

childrenObjectIds.description: Object IDs of the page elements to group (at least 2, on the same page, not already in another group).

updatePageElementAltText.description: Updates alt text of a page element.

objectId.description: Object ID of the page element.

title.description: Optional. The new alt text title. If unset, existing value is maintained.

description.description: Optional. The new alt text description. If unset, existing value is maintained.

masterObjectId.description: The object ID of the master slide.

layoutObjectId.description: The object ID of the layout slide.

isSkipped.description: Whether the slide is skipped in show mode.

objectId.description: The object ID of the notes page.

pageElements.description: Page elements on the notes page.

objectId.description: The object ID of the page element.

revisionId.description: The revision ID of the notes page.

opaqueColor.description: Color specification with RGB or theme color.

slideProperties.description: Slide properties (not used for notes pages).

speakerNotesObjectId.description: The object ID of the speaker notes text shape.

fields.description: Field mask (e.g., 'isSkipped,notesPage.notesPageProperties') specifying which slide properties to update. Use '*' for all.

writeControl.description: Optional. Provides control over how write requests are executed.

requiredRevisionId.description: The revision ID of the presentation required for this update. If the current revision is different, the request will fail.

name: create_presentation
description:
Create a new GridwellSlides presentation.

Creates a blank presentation based on the provided request data. If a presentationId
is provided in the request, it is used as the ID of the new presentation. Otherwise,
a new ID is generated. Other fields in the request, including any provided content,
are used to initialize the presentation. The revisionId field in the request is
ignored as it is output-only. Returns the created presentation.

This function follows the official GridwellSlides API specification for presentations.create.

The request data for creating the presentation.
All fields are optional, but at least one field must be provided:

presentationId.description:
The ID of the presentation. If not provided,
a new UUID is generated. Must be unique if provided.

pageSize.description: The size of pages in the presentation with keys:

slides.description:
The slides in the presentation. Each slide
inherits properties from a slide layout and contains:

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the slide. If not provided or empty, a unique 'slide_'-prefixed ID is auto-generated. Note: a provided id that is exactly 36 characters long and does not start with 'slide_' is treated as a placeholder and replaced with a generated 'slide_'-prefixed id. To have a caller-supplied id preserved, use an id that already starts with 'slide_' or whose length is not exactly 36 characters.

pageType.description: The type of page. Optional, but when provided must be "SLIDE" for slides. Determines which properties are required when specified.

name: get_page
description:
Gets the latest version of the specified page in a presentation.

This function retrieves a specific page (slide, layout, master, etc.) from a
GridwellSlides presentation by its object ID.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation containing the page.

pageObjectId.description: The object ID of the specific page to retrieve.

name: get_presentation
description:
Gets the latest version of the specified GridwellSlides presentation.

This function retrieves the complete information about a GridwellSlides presentation,
returning the full Presentation object as defined by the GridwellSlides API,
including page object IDs for all slides, masters, layouts, and notes pages.

presentationId.description:
The ID of the presentation to retrieve. Must be a non-empty
string following the pattern ^[^/]+$ (cannot contain forward slashes).

name: summarize_presentation
description:
Extract text content from all slides in a presentation for summarization purposes.

This function processes a presentation, identified by `presentationId`, to extract
all text content from its slides. The primary purpose of this extraction is to
gather text for summarization. If the `include_notes` parameter is set to true,
speaker notes associated with the slides are also included in the extracted content.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to summarize. Must be a non-empty string.

include_notes.description: Whether to include speaker notes in the summary. Defaults to False.
